lean.name: CQState
lean.plain: Partial density operators indexed by classical stores
lean.annotation: The subtype in `CQState` requires the sum of the traces to exist and be at most one. For a positive integer $n$, at most $n$ stores can each have trace at least $1/n$. Every nonzero positive semidefinite operator has positive trace, so taking the union of these finite sets accounts for every store in the support.

lean.name: CQAssertion
lean.plain: An observable for each classical store
lean.annotation: A store can test a quantum state with the projector $|+\rangle\langle+|$. Its expectation is one on $|+\rangle$ and zero on $Z|+\rangle$. Those states have identical computational-basis outcome probabilities.

lean.name: ofReal_expect_eq_tsum_support_trace_mul
lean.plain: Expectation as a sum of traces
lean.annotation: For a store with mass $p_\sigma=\operatorname{tr}(\Delta(\sigma))>0$, the contribution is $p_\sigma$ times the expectation of $\Theta(\sigma)$ in the normalized state $\Delta(\sigma)/p_\sigma$. Each contribution is bounded by $p_\sigma$, and the $p_\sigma$ sum to at most one. The theorem writes the same sum over the support of $\Delta$.
